research.title: Robustness of Intent Classification to Conversational Paraphrases
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare intent classifiers under paraphrase variation, controlling training splits and separating lexical overlap from semantic consistency.
Evaluated classifier predictions on manually reviewed paraphrases, examining confidence calibration and categorizing errors involving ambiguous requests and overlapping intent definitions.

work.title: Text Ingestion and Validation for Document Search
bullets: Implemented document ingestion components that normalized text, validated required metadata, and routed malformed records for review before search indexing.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and duplicate records, and investigated indexing discrepancies using application logs and reproducible input examples.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Extractive Summarization Methods
bullets: Implemented sentence ranking baselines using term frequency weighting and graph centrality, applying consistent preprocessing and summary length constraints across methods.
Compared summaries against reference texts using ROUGE and manual inspection, documenting differences in redundancy, topic coverage, and sensitivity to sentence segmentation.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and bidirectional recurrent baselines for entity tagging, using shared data partitions and consistent tokenization for comparison.
Evaluated entity span precision and recall, then inspected boundary errors and rare entity predictions to characterize differences between the implemented models.
